cases.note: A store without #_version_# is read under version 1.
A version-1 reader applies version 1 to lines declared version 3, so version-1 markers still work.
A store may switch versions 2, 1 and back to the default; every row is still read.

files.s.tsvz:
#_version_#	2
a	x
#_version_#	1
b	y
#_version_#
c	z

cases.note: A token a later version might define is passed through literally.
Under a declared version no reader knows, records, CRLF, the commit rule, fields, tokens, comments, markers and the empty-key rule work as in version 1.

files.s.tsvz:
#_version_#	9
#comment
a<sep>b	x<LF>y<lt>z
	q
<#>k	v
#__ext__#	w
d	tail
